# absent-constraint-widens

**Claim.** A constraint that is dropped does not raise an error — it returns more, quietly, and every test that asserts on presence still passes.

**Not when.** When the constraint is structural rather than a clause · When more is harmless · When the caller re-filters anyway

**Check.** delete the clause in a test and watch the suite go red; the bound is tested on every path that produces or reads rows

*measured.* Open the full note only when you cannot tell whether its boundary holds here: [absent-constraint-widens](../notes/active/absent-constraint-widens.md).
